title: maximalst.online
description: An anarchy server with a world that never resets, with PvP enabled in a free-for-all, no-rules environment.
body:
Welcome to maximalst.online
An anarchy Minecraft server that started with friends… and quickly spiraled out of control.

It’s a survival server with a world that never resets, with PvP enabled in a free-for-all, no-rules environment.

There are no rules! Do whatever you want. You can’t get banned, no matter what!
